ops.title: Give each payload-phase check in provision.sh its own exit code, with the next payload change
ops.description:
A failed create's pool record now names the phase, the remote exit code, and a class (v0.26.8, commit 753de42). For payload.mount it still cannot say which check failed: images/provision.sh exits 1 for every one of them, the admitted-archive check, the staged-archive check, the sha256 verify, the manifest shape and mismatch checks, and the missing sprite-env check. Distinct exit codes per check would make the record's exit field tell them apart with no error text stored.

Cost, and why it waits: provision.sh is an input of the tools fingerprint (internal/images/render.go, Fingerprint), so any edit changes the fingerprint, which forces a payload rebuild, a new payload pin in the monorepo, and a new warm pool key that orphans every ready spare. Root ruled on 2026-10-10 that this rides the next change that already rebuilds the payload, not a release of its own.

ops.text: Each failing check in provision_payload exits with its own documented code
Shipped in the same release as another payload-changing edit, with one rebuild
